feature: Chile 1970 static GDP-scaled monetary cost revision

baseline.source: GDP_SOURCE.json: fresh 31 October 2026 native game.log, 1970-01-01 Chile records at lines 1620-1622.
baseline.currency_rule: Only GDP display uses the 3.4 divisor. Treasury fees and weekly money costs remain in native internal units.

rounding.weekly_rule: A positive result below 0.000005 may round to zero; exact half steps round upward, so 0.000025 becomes 0.00003.

model_summary: Static baseline rebalance: multiply each listed non-negative monetary field by 0.05. This preserves zeros and the approved design's relative cost shape. No reward, modifier, requirement, prerequisite, title, effect, or presentation data is changed.
